answer: Proposed: agents clearing jade and vine cargo at a jetty need a human sponsor, limited to one paid key per person. Port registrars check photo ID against a shared person registry at a monthly 15-minute visit; validators deny pay for missing, invalid or duplicate attestations. Registrars must be trusted; hired sponsors can concentrate ownership. Attendance time is the recurring cost; hosts are reusable capital; no stake is locked. Shared hosts and parallel runs cannot reuse sponsors: ten keys need ten people and 150 person-minutes/month versus 15 for one key.
